sources.citation: McLean, Greg L. 2015. A Recorded Text Survey of the Mfumte Speech Varieties and Rapid Appraisal Survey of Dzodinka. SIL Electronic Survey Reports 2015-004. Dallas: SIL International. 54 pp.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. Sociolinguistic RA/RTT survey; Appendix C gives 120-item ALCAM wordlists for four Adere quarters transcribed with tone letters on every syllable (e.g. li˨lit˧ 'eye', ko˨˦ko˨˩ 'foot') but no prosodic statement. Sec. 2.4 states the only prior linguistic work is Voorhoeve 1980 (noun classes) plus an ALCAM wordlist; sec. 7.4 recommends 'complete a phonology' as future work, i.e. none existed as of 2014.

sources.citation: Grant, Caroline A., Margaret Griffin, Joseph Mbongué & Lawrence Seguin. 1994. A rapid appraisal survey of Dzodinka (ALCAM 904) and Mfumte (ALCAM 905), Donga Mantung Division, Northwest Province. Yaoundé: SIL. 21 pp. (scan; scanned at 200 dpi)
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. Sec. 1.5 'Prior linguistic work': only two 120-item wordlists (Voorhoeve & Leroy for ALCAM; Bradley 1992 for Lus) were found, 'No other prior linguistic studies on Mfumte or Dzodinka were found'.
